BETA Close X Barratt Redrow PLC has announced the purchase of 5,510,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £386 million share repurchase program. These purchases occurred between July 20 and July 24, 2026, with prices ranging from 281.0000 pence to 297.1000 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company holds no ordinary shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares stand at 1,406,112,253, with a corresponding total of 1,406,112,253 voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 27 July 2026 27 July 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 20 July 2026 to 24 July 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregate volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence) Trading venue 20 Jul 2026 551,000 291.8000 283.0000 287.7947 LSE 21 Jul 2026 551,000 286.6000 281.0000 284.6139 LSE 22 Jul 2026 551,000 297.1000 283.0000 291.1829 LSE 23 Jul 2026 551,000 295.6000 290.5000 292.8090 LSE 24 Jul 2026 551,000 296.2000 290.1000 293.8106 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 4,408,000 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays in accordance with the Buyback Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,406,112,253 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,406,112,253.
